status: frozen before any sealed refraction value was read by the model developer
context_of_use: U1 initial-state prediction of a new study's control-group mean spherical equivalent after corneal laser refractive surgery (surface ablation, LASIK or lenticule extraction) in human eyes with a plano target, from procedure, refractive error, number of eyes and the preoperative SE only
U2 causal forecasting of each human group mean's next follow-up SE (control and treated groups) from its own earlier follow-ups, with calibrated intervals
U3 landmark forecasting of every later follow-up SE of each human group mean from its first postoperative measurement only
not_claimed: biological mechanism validation (epithelial and stromal remodelling are not modelled; the law is empirical)
hyperopic or mixed-astigmatism corrections beyond the six hyperopic training series (the sealed set is myopic only)
treatment-effect prediction (treated groups use the control prior of their context)
non-plano targets, enhancement decisions, nomogram adjustment, visual acuity, astigmatism or cylinder, clinical decision use

configuration.quantity: spherical equivalent change from the preoperative SE (pseudo-fraction exp(change / 5 D))
configuration.covariate: ln(baseline / 1 pseudo-reference exp(SE0 / 5 D), so the covariate is SE0 / 5 D)

model.kinetics: change(t) / 5 D = ell + e r(t) + s q(t), r = exp(-(t - t1)/tau), q = exp(-(t - t1)/7 days), t1 = 1 day, t in months, change = SE(t) - SE0; ell = context level + b SE0 / 5 D; each procedure arm of a study has its own study effect
model.hierarchy: species -> procedure -> refractive error (contexts species/<refractive error>/<procedure>, grouping (treatment, context)); a context without training studies uses its procedure's mean with the between-context variance added, a procedure without training studies the species mean with both variances added
model.scale: the series hand generic eye model version 2 the exact pseudo-fraction exp(change / 5 D) and the pseudo-reference exp(SE0 / 5 D); eye_additive_evaluation 1.0.0 rewrites every forecast, observation and interval in tenths of a dioptre and recomputes the scores (1 pp = 0.1 D)
model.computation: generic eye recovery model version 2 with harness version 2: exact Gaussian mixtures over an 80-point tau grid 0.01..120 months, noise levels, Student-t nodes and robust components; point forecast = predictive median

methods.reference: candidate f0 (contexts species/procedure, grouping (context,)), same primaries, trained on the same records and scored in the same run
methods.secondary: the other population variants, weak_prior, analog_knn (k=5), pooled_curve_ratio, last_two_log_linear, reference_to_last_log_linear, baseline_level, target_level (plano, full correction), persistence
methods.selection_rule: declared in the development log: lowest pooled group-mean next-observation RMSE among the five population variants with group-mean coverage inside both H1 windows; ties within 0.05 pp to the Gaussian variant

f1.quantity: spherical equivalent change from the preoperative SE (pseudo-fraction exp(change / 5 D))
f1.covariate: ln(baseline / 1 pseudo-reference exp(SE0 / 5 D), so the covariate is SE0 / 5 D)

f0.quantity: spherical equivalent change from the preoperative SE (pseudo-fraction exp(change / 5 D))
f0.covariate: ln(baseline / 1 pseudo-reference exp(SE0 / 5 D), so the covariate is SE0 / 5 D)

training: the 24 development records (43 series) of the 31 reserved development studies; controls fit the population, all series give noise and analog-library inputs; for each sealed study the training studies linked to it by the author-overlap rule are removed from its training set (none are linked)

sealed_test.reserved_by: experiments/data/cornea-refraction-2026-10-29/split-reservation-1.0.0.json (8 of the 39 admitted articles, by the salted hash rule, before any value was read)
sealed_test.custodians: two sub-agents (C1, C2) extracted the sealed records and reported only structure and hashes; every record rebuilds byte for byte
sealed_test.structure_seen_before_freeze: 8 records, 14 series (all group means; 12 control, 2 treated; all myopia); contexts LASIK 10, lenticule extraction 3, surface ablation 1; methods manifest 10, unstated 4; licences 4 public, 4 private; no sealed study excluded; no refraction value (.peykar/verify_refraction_custody.py)
sealed_test.power: small: 8 studies and 14 group-mean series; verdicts on pooled targets

criteria.per_series: RMSE<=5 pp AND max<=10 pp (forecasts: AND RMSE at least 0.5 pp below persistence); 1 pp = 0.1 D, so 0.5 D, 1.0 D and 0.05 D
criteria.unit: tenths of a dioptre of spherical equivalent change from the preoperative SE
criteria.tested_subset: human group means (U2, U3) and human control group means (U1); the publisher removes every non-human series before H1-H5
criteria.H1_calibration: pooled primary next-observation coverage over group means: 80% interval within [0.70,0.90] AND 90% within [0.80,0.97]
criteria.H2_accuracy: pooled group-mean next-observation RMSE of the primary lower than each of persistence, last_two_log_linear, pooled_curve_ratio, analog_knn and target_level over common targets
criteria.H3_landmark: pooled group-mean landmark RMSE of the primary lower than each of persistence, pooled_curve_ratio, analog_knn and target_level over common targets
criteria.H4_initial_state: pooled RMSE of population_initial_state over common control group-mean targets lower than target_level (the plano target: full correction); pooled_training_curve reported only
criteria.H5_versus_f0: against f0 trained on the same records, over common human group-mean targets: the initial-state RMSE of f1 lower than f0's, AND the next-observation and landmark RMSE of f1 each at most 0.05 pp higher than f0's
criteria.reported_not_tested: treated groups separately, per-context results, landmark and initial-state coverage, per-series criteria counts
criteria.all_points: every sealed series/target is scored; none removed; thresholds unchanged after unsealing
criteria.publication: studies whose licence does not permit republishing values keep only per-series metrics and an allow-list of initial-state fields

publication_operator: uv run --frozen python scripts/publish_refraction_population.py --sealed --report <dir>/report.json --reference <dir>/reference-f0-report.json --output <new public dir>
